worker_profile: Direct metered OpenRouter calls through the benchmark harness path (MeteringProxy + harness._call_model, max_tokens 2048, full benchmark prompt) on a deterministic benchmark-stratified sample of the pinned pool (40 questions per model; 24 for mistralai/mistral-large-2512, upstream-rate-limited), recorded 2026-11-02 by scripts/record_token_observations.py; provider usage counts; table-priced and provider-billed cost per row.

reviewed_by: Jack Doherty (Fugal Labs; approval of the promotion PR is the human review)
review.method: 664 metered calls recorded through the benchmark's own proxy and call path on a deterministic stratified sample of the pinned pool (pool_hash 1779b4a5218bb2effed85729f345f2766b010e2c33a36e6d3afe7c1a05a4b4df); means of provider-reported prompt and completion tokens per model.
limitations: 40 samples per model (24 for mistralai/mistral-large-2512, which was upstream-rate-limited on OpenRouter's shared pool for the whole session) is a cost interface, not a workload study.
Questions are drawn from the benchmark pool, not from a user workload.
Completion means sit well above medians for terse models and are capped at max_tokens 2048 for long-reasoning ones; the manifest stores the mean because the cost estimate needs the mean.
Changing any number here changes the protocol identity and resets all accumulated evidence; this manifest is expected to stand for the first launch period.
review.supersedes: candidate of 2026-09-21 (945 calls from three pre-transition proof bundles, three samples for most models)
